Subject: Cordelia Health — Inference POC: proposed demo slots and logistics

Hi Ayesha / Tom,

Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday — great discussion on where inference could speed up triage and summarization for your care ops. Per our conversation, I have two demo slots next week that would fit the cross-functional audience you mentioned (product + infra):

- Tue, Mar 13 — 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu, Mar 15 — 14:00–14:45 PT

Would either of those work? We can tailor the runbook to show both latency/cost tradeoffs and a short security/integration fragment.

I've attached a short POC deck (two slides) that outlines the agenda and what we’ll need on your side (sample requests, a safe subset of data). If neither slot works, happy to propose the next week.

Next steps: confirm a slot and a list of 4–6 attendees (PM, infra lead, 2 product owners).

Best,
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks Markus — appreciate the quick follow-up and the deck. Two quick updates from our side:

1) Travel: Our Head of Product (Tom) is traveling the week of Mar 13 for investor meetings and won’t be available for either slot.
2) Roadmap reprioritization: Leadership has shifted focus this quarter to an infrastructure consolidation initiative. That means we’re pulling several exploratory efforts (including ML inference POCs) into backlog grooming for now.

At this point the honest ask is: can we park the demo? We do want to keep this on the radar — we liked the ideas you showed — but need to reallocate cycles for the next 8–12 weeks. If possible, please put us on a short nurture cadence and we’ll re-evaluate at the next product planning meeting in late May.

If you have a one-pager on minimal integration effort or a sandbox we can self-validate later, that would be helpful to share with stakeholders.

Apologies for the shifting schedule — happy to revisit once the consolidation work settles down.

Best,
Ayesha Khan
Director, Product Operations | Cordelia Health
ayesha@cordelia.health | +1 206-555-9876

Ayesha — thank you for the update and the candor. Totally understand the need to reprioritize — these cycles are real.

Quick plan from our side:
- We’ll release the proposed demo slots and mark the opportunity as "nurture / backlog" in our tracker.
- I’ll send a one-page integration summary and a short sandbox invite you can use asynchronously (no Tom required).
- If it helps, we can also provide an objective readiness checklist your infra team can use to assess lift (1–2 hours).

I’ve attached a lightweight nurture plan that outlines a 6–8 week touch cadence (email + one async sandbox check-in). No pressure — just options to keep momentum without blocking your roadmap.

Would you like us to send the one-pager and sandbox details to you only, or include Tom when he returns in mid-April?

Regards,
Markus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.ai

Attachments: nurture-plan.docx (docx, 45KB)
